push-checks-before.quantity: the push's checks that read the tree, each timed as push_cmd runs it, the second of two runs (warm), summed
push-checks-before.method: each command run twice, the second run's wall time kept; the rows summed

push-checks-runner-after.quantity: the push's Python checks run by push_checks.py in one process, warm (the second of two runs) - the same checks as push-checks-before plus gate-stamp and the closing check
push-checks-runner-after.source: this clone after phases 1 and 2; load 4.5
push-checks-runner-after.method: the first row of the harness, second of two runs

push-checks-separate-after.quantity: the same checks as push-checks-before, each its own process, warm, summed (the runner row left out)
push-checks-separate-after.source: this clone after phases 1 and 2; load 4.5
push-checks-separate-after.method: every row but the first, second of two runs each, summed

land-tooling-landing-before.quantity: a real make land-tooling, every step, before amendment 2's cuts

land-tooling-landing-after.quantity: a real make land-tooling, every step, with amendment 2's cuts

claims-gate-push.quantity: scripts/gates/claims-gate.sh, warm, before and after the base memo

land-tooling-landing-a3.quantity: a real make land-tooling, every step, with amendment 3's cuts
